rationale: Colin and Rid both work on multi-agent AI systems and infrastructure, with Colin building inference layers at Nebius while Rid develops multi-agent coordination systems at Rutgers—including shared memory for agent coordination that directly benefits from the kind of purpose-built infrastructure Colin advocates for. They share Accenture background and overlapping tech stacks (Python, TypeScript), and Colin's conviction that engineered inference is the competitive advantage aligns with Rid's applied ML robotics work that depends on robust agent infrastructure.
intro_message: Colin Nebius, meet Rid M — you're both building multi-agent systems from different angles (infrastructure vs. application layer) and share Accenture experience and a Python/TypeScript stack.
